sloka: हविर्धानेषु यः सोमम् उपहन्ति महाबलः ।प्राप्त यज्ञ हरम् दुष्टम् ब्रह्म घ्नम् क्रूर कारिणम् ॥३-३२-२०॥
transliteration: havirdhāneṣu yaḥ somam upahanti mahābalaḥ ।prāpta yajña haram duṣṭam brahma ghnam krūra kāriṇam ॥3-32-20॥

translations.english: He disrupted sacrifices at the final stage. He killed brahmins. He was ruthless, harsh, and merciless. He was involved in activities against human welfare.
